title: Fuel type.
officialText:
An appliance shall be designed for use with the type of fuel to which it will be connected. Such appliance shall not be
converted from the fuel specified on the rating plate for use with a different fuel without conforming with its listing and manufacturers
specifications and securing reapproval from the commissioner.
